method: apps/web/bench.html (src/bench): stress fixture (seed 1); proxy layers for edges, ring cards, ticks and streaks; the busiest second of the run looped for 8 s after a 1 s warm-up; fixed DPR per case; fresh WebGL context per case. Interval = requestAnimationFrame timestamp deltas; cpu = stage frame() time (layer updates, uploads, render call). Timer resolution 0.1 ms; values rounded to 0.1 ms.
